styleGuide.title: Style guide

howTo.title: Colors are changed in a single place
howTo.description: FundTrack uses the same colors as InvenTrack, in light and dark mode. They are all in the file below: change a value there and the whole app updates.

styleGuide.semanticHint: Components only use these names, never a fixed color.
styleGuide.statusHint: For difference statuses and errors. They stay the same with any brand color.
styleGuide.hintBody: It is the local fund balance at month close, as shown in ACMS.

login.title: Sign in
login.welcomeDescription: Track the local fund counts of every church in the mission from one place, simply and securely.

placeholder.description: This screen is still under construction.

home.title: Home
home.overdueTitle: Open months past their due date:

cards.negativeAcmsDetail: Churches that spent more than they had

amounts.differenceHint: Count minus ACMS: negative is missing, positive is extra

funds.sampleOnly: Sample view: nothing is saved yet.

counts.subtitle: Local fund count of every church and group for the month. Branches are included in the count of their parent church.
counts.noCountYet: The count has not been recorded yet
counts.noPeriods: There are no periods yet. Create them in Catalogs, Periods, with Generate year.
counts.closedPeriod: This period is closed: its counts can no longer be edited. To fix an amount, open the count and record a correction.

dialog.notSubmittedHint: It is recorded as Not submitted. Only the ACMS balance is saved.
dialog.differenceWillBePending: When saved, the difference is recorded. The ACMS covers what is short or over.
dialog.uploadHint: Photo of the ledger or the count record. PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MB.
dialog.noFollowUps: The difference has no follow-up yet.
dialog.correctionsHint: Corrections are used when the month is already closed: the original count does not change and the correction applies to the open month.
dialog.closedHint: The period is closed: the count is read only. Errors are fixed with a correction.
dialog.deleteMessage: Delete the {{period}} count for {{church}}? Its follow-up and attachments are deleted too.
dialog.uploadInvalid: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files up to 10 MB are accepted.
dialog.correctionSaved: Correction recorded in the open period.
dialog.localCash: Local currency bills and coins (local fund)
dialog.documentsTitle: Documents (invoices, receipts and others to account for)
dialog.custodyTotal: Total funds in the treasurer's custody
dialog.differenceReason: Observation: why is there a difference?
dialog.printError: The count could not be prepared for printing.
dialog.fixBeforePrint: Complete the fields marked in red before printing.

differences.subtitle: Counts where the total in custody does not match the ACMS balance. The ACMS covers what is short or over; here it is only recorded and, if needed, marked as resolved.

hint.resolved: The Mission closes the difference. Write the reason.

regions.cannotDelete: It has districts: move them before deleting it.

districts.cannotDelete: It has churches: move them before deleting it.
districts.assignHint: The district's current assignment, and the chosen pastor's if they had another district, ends the day before this date.
districts.noHistory: This district has had no pastors assigned yet.

pastors.cannotDelete: They have a district: assign another pastor to it before deleting them.
pastors.search: Search by name, ID or email
pastors.ciHint: Optional: it can be left empty.
pastors.districtHint: The district is changed from Districts, with Assign pastor, so it stays in the history.

churches.subtitle: Branches share their mother church's code and have no count of their own.
churches.alreadyClosed: It is already closed or merged.
churches.closeFilialsBlocked: It has {{count}} active branch(es). Close them or move them to another church first.
churches.changeHint: You changed the type, district or name: it will be recorded in the history with this date and reason.

periods.subtitle: A closed period is never reopened. Differences in a closed month are fixed with corrections.
periods.generateHint: Creates only the missing months, each due on the 15th of the following month.
periods.dueDateHint: After this date the period shows as overdue while it stays open.
periods.closeMessage: Counts for this month can no longer be added or edited, and it cannot be reopened. Continue?
periods.closedLocked: It is closed and can no longer be changed.
periods.cannotDelete: It is closed and has counts: it cannot be deleted.

import.title: Import churches from Excel
import.hint: The file is reviewed first without saving anything. If there are no errors, it can be saved. With a single error, no row is saved.
import.pastorStartDateHint: When each pastor starts in their district.
import.ready: Review passed: {{rows}} rows without errors. You can save now.
import.hasErrors: The file has errors: fix them and review it again. Nothing was saved.

users.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? If they already recorded data it cannot be deleted: deactivate them instead.
users.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own user.
users.search: Search by name, email or ID
users.linkedPastorHint: Only for users with the Pastor role: it sets which district they see.
users.tempPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. The user changes it on first login.
users.newPasswordHint: Leave it empty to keep it. If filled, the account is unlocked and the user changes it on login.
users.pastorRoleNeedsLink: This user has no linked pastor: with the Pastor role they would see no district. Link one in Edit.

roles.subtitle: What each role can do is fixed in the system. Here you choose which menus it sees.
roles.deleteWithUsers: "{{name}}" has {{count}} user(s): they lose this role if it is deleted. Continue?
roles.protected: The M-BOS role cannot be renamed, deactivated or deleted.
roles.newRoleHint: A new role can only view: recording data is limited to M-BOS and Analista.
roles.protectedMenus: The M-BOS role always sees every menu.
roles.deleteMessage: Delete the role "{{name}}"? Users who have it will lose it. This cannot be undone.

audit.subtitle: Every saved change is kept here with who made it. It is kept for 3 years.
audit.maskedHint: Passwords and tokens are stored hidden (***).

account.mustChange: You signed in with a temporary password. Change it to keep using the system.

400.title: Invalid request
400.description: The request could not be processed. Check the data and try again.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.description: You need to sign in to access this content.

403.title: Access denied
403.description: You don't have permission to view this section.

404.title: Page not found
404.description: The content you're looking for doesn't exist or was moved.

500.title: Server error
500.description: Something unexpected happened. Please try again later.

503.title: Service unavailable
503.description: The service isn't available right now. Please try again later.

default.title: An error occurred
default.description: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reports.error: The report could not be generated.
reports.excelError: The Excel file could not be downloaded.
reports.selectPrompt: Choose the filters to see the report.
reports.noPreview: This browser cannot show PDFs inside the page: use Download PDF.

local-fund.title: Annual local fund
local-fund.description: ACMS balance, total in custody and difference for each church, month by month.

pending.title: Monthly pending
pending.description: Churches that did not record or submit their count, or with an unresolved difference, by district and pastor.

differences.title: Differences by status
differences.description: Counts that do not match the ACMS: amount, status, days open and last follow-up.

compliance.title: Compliance by district and pastor
compliance.description: Percentage of counts recorded by each overdue month's due date.

negative-acms.title: Negative ACMS balance
negative-acms.description: Churches that spent more than they had and for how many months in a row.

region-summary.title: Monthly summary by region or district
region-summary.description: For each month: active churches, how many submitted, did not submit, did not record, with a difference, and the amounts. Group it by region or district.

corrections.title: Applied corrections
corrections.description: What was corrected in closed months, where it was applied, who did it, the previous and new amounts.

church-movements.title: Church changes
church-movements.description: Churches closed, merged or with a district, type or name change between two dates.

local-fund-count.title: Local fund count sheet
local-fund-count.description: The count sheet to print and sign: treasurer, pastor and elder. One sheet per church; choose a church or a whole district.

reports.pickDistrictOrChurch: Choose a district or a church to see its counts.
